note: Reconciled against the released v1.3.1 / v1.3.0 entries in CHANGELOG. Mention shipped work only in the Project description; do not create issues retroactively. For unchecked v1.3 items in HANDOFF.md, the changelog takes precedence.

exploring.title: [Feature] 1080p60 export
exploring.body: External PR #82 bundled 1080p60, an all-English interface, and migration scripts; it was not merged. If reconsidered, evaluate export specifications separately and do not reopen that PR.
acceptance: Define an explicit export specification instead of changing the interface language as a side effect

exploring.title: [Feature] Speaker-centered crop and cover images
exploring.body: Vertical publishing exports already support blurred backgrounds, cropping, burned-in subtitles, and title cards. Speaker-centered framing and cover images are not implemented, and no community discussion has moved them into the committed scope.
acceptance: Establish a use case before deciding whether to move this out of Exploring

researching.title: [Feature] Pluggable ASR backends
researching.body: Issue #67. Define the ASRBackend protocol first, with faster-whisper as the default implementation. Integrate specific providers such as SenseVoice after the protocol is complete; do not couple provider code before the interface is defined.

researching.title: [Feature] Clip quality comparison
researching.body: Duration profiles and score fallbacks are already on main. We still need comparisons using one real five-minute video and one real 60-minute video, with results added to backend/eval/cases.
acceptance: Add comparison results for both real videos to the evaluation cases

researching.title: [Feature] Pluggable Step 3 scoring backends
researching.body: Following the direction in #75: define the protocol before evaluating providers. Do not integrate TwelveLabs or other scoring services until the interface is finalized.
acceptance: Define the protocol in code while keeping the current scoring as the default implementation

planned.title: [Feature] Validate the Windows installer on a physical machine
planned.body: The Windows installer has been available in Releases since v1.2.1, but as of v1.3.1 there is still no record of processing a video on a clean Windows installation.
acceptance: On a clean Windows installation, launch the app, save a provider, and process one local video

planned.title: [Feature] Apple notarization and Windows code signing
planned.body: As of v1.3.1, the app can check for and install updates, but installers are still ad-hoc signed. Apple Developer ID notarization and Windows code signing are not yet set up, so macOS still requires opening the app via the context menu and Windows may show a SmartScreen warning. Signing keys for update bundles are not yet a release prerequisite.
acceptance: macOS no longer requires opening via the context menu
Windows installation no longer warns about an unknown publisher

planned.title: [Feature] Redesign the home page and project cards using the design system
planned.body: Settings and detail pages have been migrated according to DESIGN.md, and the eight-language interface shipped in v1.3.1. The home-page import panel, project cards, collection dialog, and Bilibili login dialog still use Ant Design defaults.
acceptance: Use primitives from frontend/src/ui for home-page imports and project cards
Remove gradients and clashing colors prohibited by DESIGN.md

planned.title: [Feature] End-to-end CLI / MCP test with a real video
planned.body: Commands and MCP tools have unit tests, but none has processed a real video to completion. Consider a Homebrew tap and PyPI after this is verified.
acceptance: autoclip run reports completed for a real video
MCP start_clip_job can poll for the same result

planned.title: [Feature] Intel Mac installer
planned.body: Windows x64 shipped with v1.2.1. There is no Intel Mac installer yet. A Linux desktop package is outside the scope of this item.
acceptance: Publish an Intel Mac installer in Releases

planned.title: [Feature] Connect chunk size and collection count settings to the pipeline
planned.body: Settings can already save chunk_size and max_clips_per_collection. min_score is connected to step3, but step1 / step5 do not yet read these two settings.
acceptance: The next processing run uses the updated chunk size and collection count

planned.title: [Feature] Human review of three vertical presets
planned.body: 9:16 exports for Douyin, Shorts, and Bilibili shipped in v1.3.0. This item tracks reviewing one finished clip from each of the three presets; it does not duplicate the export feature.
acceptance: A person has reviewed one finished clip from each preset for subtitles and title cards

shipped.title: v1.3.1: Eight-language interface, crash reporting, and in-app update checks
v1.3.0: Failure-stage messages, Qwen international service, Docker settings page, vertical exports, CLI / MCP
v1.2.1: Docker builds, worker queue processing, and Windows installer
